title: ITSP.10.171 identifier issuance, status and non-reuse need operating evidence
remediation: The sponsor identity governance lead defines authorization and non-reuse periods for individual, group, role, service and device identifiers, plus required individual status markers. Sample approved assignment and retirement, and verify the corresponding recovery or non-reuse handling for the observed period. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect approved issuance and non-reuse rules with redacted identity assignment, status and retirement samples
